feed.title: 'Not nearly enough' - Stroll's verdict on Honda's F1 engine upgrade
feed.summary: Lance Stroll expressed disappointment with Honda's upgraded F1 engine, stating it's "not nearly enough" of an improvement after Aston Martin's double Q1 elimination at the Dutch Grand Prix. feed.title: 4th Circuit cuts fired Wells Fargo exec’s award from $22M to $18M
feed.summary: The 4th US Circuit Court of Appeals has reduced a former Wells Fargo Securities executive's award from $22 million to approximately $18 million. Christopher John Billesdon sued Wells Fargo after being fired in 2022, alleging discrimination due to a disability requiring frequent restroom access and retaliation for requesting to work permanently from home. The court upheld the jury's finding of retaliation under the Americans with Disabilities Act but struck down other liability verdicts and portions of the monetary relief.
